messages:
kevin: Quick summary from the astra-13b quant sweep (H100 / A100, us-east / eu-west / ap-south).
kevin: Ran FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 profiles with 2048 context, batch=8, streaming disabled.
kevin: TL;DR:
- INT8: 2.5–2.8x throughput vs FP16 on H100; 2.0–2.2x on A100
- FP8: 1.9–2.1x on H100, quality indistinguishable from FP16 on our chat-eval
- BF16 ~ parity with FP16 latency, slight memory win
- INT8 had a small quality drop on the multi-turn summarization set (ROUGE-L -0.6 pts); FP8 didn't show that

sara: Can you paste the run command and kernel flags?

kevin: Sure:
```bash
./bench_runner --model astra-13b --quant_profiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 \\n  --gpus H100,A100 --regions us-east,eu-west,ap-south \\n  --context 2048 --batch 8 --kernels fused_gemm_v2,default_triton \\n  --save /tmp/bench/astra_qprofiles.json
```

perf-bot: Automated summary (from /tmp/bench/astra_qprofiles.json):
- H100 FP16: throughput 12.3k tok/s, p50=6.1ms, p99=47ms
- H100 INT8: throughput 31.0k tok/s (+2.52x), p50=5.8ms, p99=50ms
- H100 FP8: throughput 23.4k tok/s (+1.90x), p50=5.9ms
- A100 FP16: throughput 9.8k tok/s, A100 INT8: 20.6k (+2.10x)
- EU-west numbers ~5-7% slower than us-east (kernel + infra variance)
- AP-south shows 8-12% slower due to older driver stack

elaine: Which kernel combo was fastest for INT8 on H100?

kevin: fused_gemm_v2 + kv-cache-tiling gave the best tail behavior. default_triton had slightly lower p99 on small batches but worse throughput overall.
kevin: Also saw jittery p95 when batching >16 on A100 for INT8; suspect kernel launch contention / CUDA stream limits.

matt: For capacity planning, what's our estimate per-GPU qps for a chat workload (avg 32 tokens / request)?

kevin: rough numbers (avg 32 tokens/request, include decode loop overhead):
- H100 INT8: ~970 req/s
- H100 FP16: ~385 req/s
- A100 INT8: ~640 req/s
- A100 FP16: ~310 req/s

sara: Any quality regressions we should flag to research?

kevin: yes: INT8 regression on summarization set (set id S-7). example diffs: 4/100 samples had hallucinated facts vs FP16 baseline. FP8 looked safe on the same evals.
kevin: I'll add a focused calibrator run and push the failing examples to the eval dashboard.

elaine: Can we push a canary with FP8 on Dedicated? ops-bot, any capacity impact?

ops-bot: Canary ok on dedicated pool "d-pool-eu" with 3 x H100 nodes. Will monitor mem/cpu and alert if p99 > 120ms or error rate > 0.5%.

matt: Thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and set a warm-up policy for the canary. Can we add kernel override per-region in routing policy so eu-west uses fused_gemm_v2?

kevin: Yep, opening a PR with region->kernel hints and quant profile defaults. tagging @sara for eval dashboards and @elaine for rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
